description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the JobCategoryAPI, part of the OrangeHRM admin API suite. It contains test methods for the CRUD operations (get all, get one, create, update, delete) on job categories, using data-driven testing with data providers. The class extends a base test case and sets up test data fixtures before each test.
